system_note: Claim MR_SNF_07, revenue code 0192 billed 10 units for 2026-01-08 through 2026-01-21. Medical record supports skilled PT/OT services on multiple dates but the retrieved, citable daily nursing/therapy notes do not document all 10 distinct dates that would be required to verify the full 10 billed 0192 days. Evidence: the Admission H&P documents transfer to the SNF for skilled PT/OT/nursing (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_07.pdf-n10, p.8) and the interdisciplinary plan documents PT/OT frequency of 5-7x/week (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_07.pdf-n12, pp.10-11). The Treatment Administration Records (TARs) available and retrieved show explicit PT and/or OT sessions documented on the following dates (cited below): 01/08 (n120 p139), 01/09 (n121 p140), 01/12 (n124 p143), 01/13 (n125 p144), 01/14 (n126 p145), 01/15 (n127 p146), and 01/16 (n128 p147). Each of those TAR entries documents PT 60 minutes and/or OT 45 minutes completed per schedule and therefore supports those specific dates as skilled therapy days. However, the claim bills 10 units at 0192 and the retrieved TARs with source_ids only document therapy sessions on seven citable dates; therapy-session rows for 01/19–01/21 were returned by the system’s service-minute extraction tool (non-source_id rows) but those session rows lack a medical-record source_id in the retrieval set and therefore cannot be cited as supporting evidence in this audit. Additionally, there are pre-flagged internal record conflicts (and ) indicating the facility billing summary/discharge summary and the daily skilled nursing progress notes disagree about which days are at which per-diem level; those conflicts were flagged as “do not trust: either” and the record does not resolve them. Because the documentation set in the retrieval does not provide citable, day-by-day per-diem determinations or citable therapy/TAR entries for all billed 10 days at 0192, I could not rely solely on the TAR extraction to support all billed 0192 days. Determination: Finding. Corrections applied: Rev Code 0191 — 3 day(s) billed; corrected to 13 day(s). rationale_letter:
Re: MR_SNF_07 - SNF Per-Diem Review (01/08/2026-01/21/2026) Dear Provider, We completed an audit of the SNF per-diem revenue lines on this claim, which billed 10 day(s) at Rev Code 0192 (Level 2, rehabilitation therapy), 3 day(s) at Rev Code 0191 (Level 1, skilled nursing) for 01/08/2026-01/21/2026. Basis for Finding:
- The facility's Skilled Nursing Progress Notes record the per-diem level for each day of the stay; they document Level 1, skilled nursing (Rev 0191) on 14 day(s).
- Under the SNF level-of-care guidance, each billed day is held to the level its own documentation supports (per-day adjustment), not the stay as a whole. Correction Applied:
- Rev Code 0191: 3 day(s) billed; corrected to 13 day(s).
- Rev Code 0192: 10 day(s) billed; corrected to 0 day(s).
- The claim's revenue lines share one date range, so the claim does not identify which dates the recoded days fall on. Recovery Type: see corrections If you believe additional documentation supports the billed level for specific days, please submit it with a request for reconsideration within the timeframe specified in the applicable provider manual and appeal rights notice. Sincerely,
Clinical Review Team
